# drizzle-cubrid

> Drizzle ORM dialect for the CUBRID database. Independently maintained community adapter, not an official Drizzle dialect. TypeScript-first, built on Drizzle's MySQL query builders. Node.js 18+.

drizzle-cubrid brings Drizzle ORM's type-safe query builder to CUBRID, built on top of cubrid-client. It supports CUBRID-specific types (SET, MULTISET, SEQUENCE, MONETARY), MySQL-compatible SQL generation, and transactions with savepoints.

Key facts:
- Install: `npm install drizzle-cubrid drizzle-orm cubrid-client`
- Define schema: `cubridTable('users', { id: int('id').primaryKey().autoincrement(), name: varchar('name', { length: 100 }) })`
- Connect: `const db = drizzle(createClient({ host: "localhost", port: 33000, database: "demodb", user: "dba", timezone: "utc" }))` (`timezone: "utc"` is required to read date and time columns)
- Query: `await db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.name, 'Alice'))`
- Imports: `drizzle`, `cubridTable`, column builders, `eq`/`and`/`or`/`asc`/`desc`/`sql` and similar come from `drizzle-cubrid`; `relations`, `like`, `inArray` and other helpers come from `drizzle-orm`; `createClient`/`createPool` from `cubrid-client`
- CUBRID-specific column types: `set()`, `multiset()`, `sequence()` (also exported as `cubridSet()`, `cubridMultiset()`, `cubridSequence()`), `monetary()`
- Not supported: relational queries with `with`, streaming (`.iterator()`), schema migrations/DDL generation, JSON/BLOB/CLOB column builders; only CUBRID 11.4 is tested
- Offline unit tests with a 95% coverage gate, plus a live CUBRID 11.4 suite in CI
- TypeScript-first with full type inference from schema definitions

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/README.md): Full documentation with schema definition, queries, custom types, transactions
- [Product Requirements](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/docs/PRD.md): Current shipped behavior versus the planned CUBRID-native design

## Examples

- [Define Schema](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/README.md#1-define-your-schema): Table and column definition with cubridTable
- [Query Examples](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/README.md#2-connect-and-query): Insert, select, where, update, delete operations
- [CUBRID-Specific Types](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/README.md#cubrid-specific-column-types): SET, MULTISET, SEQUENCE, MONETARY column types
- [Transactions](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/README.md#transactions): Transaction support with automatic commit/rollback

## API Reference

- [Source — index.ts](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/src/index.ts): Public API exports — drizzle(), cubridTable, column types
- [Source — driver.ts](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/blob/main/src/driver.ts): Drizzle driver adapter for cubrid-client
- [Source — columns/](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid/tree/main/src/columns): Column type definitions including CUBRID-specific types

## Ecosystem

- [cubrid-client](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-client): TypeScript CUBRID driver (required dependency)
- [Drizzle ORM](https://orm.drizzle.team/): The Drizzle ORM framework
- [CUBRID](https://www.cubrid.org/): The CUBRID database
